findings.description: 26个浏览器操作枚举: navigate/screenshot/click/type/getText/scroll/getPageInfo/executeJS/findElements/hover/getReadable/setUserAgent/setViewport/getBackbone/fetch/newTab/closeTab/listTabs/getCookies/setCookies/scrollAndCollect/waitForDomStable

浏览器动作输入结构体。parse(from:)解析Agent JSON指令，supported fields: action/url/selector/text/coordinate_x/coordinate_y/direction/amount/script/user_agent/max_depth/tab_id/scroll_count/item_selector/keywords/fuzzy/timeout/viewport_width/viewport_height/viewport_reset/full_page/cookies。cookies字段同时接受[[String:Any]]和JSON字符串两种形态
三种预置UA: mobile_safari(390x844 iOS 18 Safari)/desktop_safari(1280x800 macOS Safari)/custom(自定义UA字符串)。每种对应逻辑viewport大小和desktop/mobile contentMode。preferredContentMode影响移动端/桌面端layout协商
结果模型: text/success/base64Image(给LLM vision)/imageFilePath(本地磁盘)/fetchedFileData(下载Data)/fetchedFileName/pageURL/tabId(实际执行tab标识防fan-out分支误判tab)

核心浏览器管理器@MainActor。@property: currentURL/pageTitle/isLoading/loadError/canGoBack/canGoForward/lastScreenshot。execute(action:)分发26类操作；visualChangeAction后waitForDomSettleAndSnapshot注入DOM MutationObserver收集3秒summary并截图；evaluateJavaScriptBounded用GCD DispatchSourceTimer保障JS执行wall-clock超时(解决后台Task.sleep被CPU throttling拉长)。sharedProcessPool保证跨tab OAuth流程共享session。navigationTimeout=30秒

WKWebView工厂: sharedProcessPool+websiteDataStore=.default()+allowsContentJavaScript+注册MinisURLSchemeHandler(处理minis://scheme)+注入printBridge(解决WKWebView忽略window.print)+desktop viewport meta override(替换meta[name=viewport]+preferredContentMode desktop/mobile
UIViewRepresentable包装BrowserUseManager.webView接入SwiftUI

全屏沉浸式WKWebView Host用于WebAppShortcut。安全策略: (1)仅loadFileURL(_:allowingReadAccessTo:)；(2)导航策略拒绝所有非file:/about:URL(http/https/data:/自定义scheme含minis://全blocked)；(3)iOS 17+ per-shortcut隔离WKWebsiteDataStore(forIdentifier:)；(4)无WKScriptMessageHandler+window.webkit未设置+无userContentController注入。左边缘swipe退出+右下角悬浮菜单

全量浏览器操作JS库，每方法返回IIFE+JSON.stringify。实现: click(selector)全事件序列mouseover→mouseenter→mousemove→mousedown→mouseup→click→mouseleave→mouseout；clickCoordinate(x,y)通过document.elementFromPoint；type(selector,text)使用nativeSetter(=getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set)绕过React/Vue，逐字符触发keydown/keypress/input/keyup+Angular $forceUpdate+Vue $forceUpdate+blur/focusout；getText(selector?) body/selector两种模式+10k字符cap+debug对象(visible/hidden统计/readyState/scrollHeight)；getReadable候选选择器article/[role=main]/main/.post-content等15k trim文本+matchedSelector；scroll(direction,amount,selector?) 自动发现最大可滚动容器overflowY auto/scroll+walk 10 levels deep；scrollToElement用scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'})；hover模拟mouseenter+mouseover；findElements(selector) querySelectorAll返回前20完整rect+visibility+text+href；getBackbone(maxDepth): 复杂DOM骨架化-visible leaf筛选→bubble-merge rectsClose注入分组节点→DOM containment建树→flatten空group→trimDepth→输出含selector/rect/pageXY/input；scrollAndCollect(direction,amount,scrollCount,selector,itemSelector): MutationObserver观测300ms settle+2s max wait+500 item/30k char cap+80字符去重key；getPageInfo返回url/title/scrollY/scrollHeight/viewport/readyState/forms/links/images
浏览器历史单例@MainActor。7天retentionDays+按日分组groupedByDay+连续同URL去重+about:blank忽略。持久化到Application Support/MinisChat/browser_history.json。clearAll全删；record(url:title)插入队首
SwiftUI历史视图:按日section分组+HH:mm时间戳+monospaced URL+Clear All确认弹窗+空状态icon。onSelect(String)回调

WKWebsiteDataStore.default().httpCookieStore的WKHTTPCookieStoreObserver实时审计。两层: (1)Live diff-cookiesDidChange触发400ms合并burst后diff vs上次快照，log added/removed/modified；(2)Offline diff-快照持久化到cookie_audit_snapshot.json，app launch时与上次diff检测ITP离线wipe。CookieMeta仅记录valueLength/expires/httpOnly，从不记录值

WebKit ITP反制系统。解决agent headless浏览(无user gesture)导致prevalent domain HttpOnly cookie被30天wipe。每次browser_use action前(60s节流)syncIfNeeded: (1)将所有cookie备份为Netscape cookies.txt格式到Application Support/BrowserCookieBackup/<registrable-domain>.txt(对HttpOnly domain用#HttpOnly_前缀)；(2)从备份恢复live store缺失的cookie(full metadata)。backup域使用registrable domain归并。文件completeUntilFirstUserAuthentication加密+isExcludedFromBackup+永不离开设备。域30天未访问drop backup+stop restore(visit clock由真实navigation重置)。maxDomains=1000硬cap。legacy JSON→txt migration

设置管理SwiftUA: UserAgentSection(3选项+custom编辑+contextMenu复制)；ViewportSection(默认/Custom+width×height+6预设iPhone/iPhone Pro/iPad/Laptop/Desktop/Full HD+UA-viewport mismatch warning banner mobileUA width>=768或desktopUA width<768触发)；CookiesSection(cookieCount+Clear All→CookieBackupStore.forgetAll)；DomainListSection(按域分组+swipeActions删除+cookieStore.deleteCookie+reconcileDomainAfterUserEdit反写同步)。搜索栏filter by domain

浏览器sheet SwiftUI容器: Tab bar+URL Address Bar(keyboardType=.URL+onSubmit→loadURL)+导航按钮(Back/Forward/Stop/Reload/Fullscreen)+WebLoadErrorOverlay(Safari-style)+AgentBrowsingOverlay(isAgentBusy锁定+onTakeover回调)+BrowserDownloadBanner+fullscreen退出按钮

进程级tab配额注册表@MainActor。globalTabCap=8。requestSlot两阶段驱逐: pass1最旧idle non-inUse tab，pass2最旧busy inUse(tab reclaimed retry错误)。handleMemoryWarning驱逐所有non-inUse tab。allTabSnapshots返回sessionId/tabId/url/title/isLoading/inUse/lastActivityAgo。每pool默认maxTabs=3
WKDownload支持。downloadCenterIds映射ObjectIdentifier→UUID+hasInflightDownloads+sessionIdProvider/tabIdProvider由pool绑定+inflightDownloads字典持有WKDownload生命周期(weak delegate)+downloadDestinations记录目标host
浏览器资源诊断监控(监测WKWebView内存/进程状态)

用户挂载外部文件夹(如Obsidian vault)通过security-scoped bookmark。字段: id(UUID)/name(→/var/minis/mounts/<name>)/sourceDisplayName/bookmark/security-scoped数据/isWritable(OS级)/userAllowWrite(用户意图)/effectiveWritable(两者同时成立)。validMountName验证非空/非./不含/或\0。MountActivationState: active/stale/permissionDenied/failed/contentsUnavailable(第三方FileProvider未materialize)

将(scope,scopeContext,relativeHtmlPath)解析为(host htmlURL, readAccessRoot)对。scope: sessionAttachment(minisAttachmentsPersistentDir)/sessionWorkspace(minisWorkspacePersistentDir)/shared(minisSharedPersistentDir)/mount(MountedFoldersManager.shared.resolvedURL)。路径逃逸检测prefix拒绝../other-session。session readAccessRoot=session root，mount/shared=base本身

Skill数据模型符合Anthropic SKILL.md: id(String slugify)/name/description/version/importSource(URL/file/bundled/session)/isEnabled/installedAt/updatedAt/body(frontmatter后SKILL.md内容)/useCount(0-100标准化)/sourceURL(计算属性)

SKILL.md YAML解析器。标准--- opening/closing fence + headless frontmatter(无opening fence但含key:value+closing fence，需至少含name/description/version之一作recognized key门控)。支持YAML block scalars |-/>-/>+ (fold/newline保留)。字段: name/description/version(=default 1.0.0)/body

技能商店@MainActor @Published skills。SQLite persistence Library/MinisChat/skills.db。表: skills(8字段)+session_skill_overrides(session_id/skill_id/is_enabled)。init依次openDatabase/loadSkills/installBundledSkills(内置2.1.0 skill-creator)/migrateMarkBundledSkillsDirty
系统提示Top-20 Skill元数据注入。enabled→排序updatedAt desc+name asc tiebreak→prefix 20→每行- <id>: <note截断200字符>

设置级技能管理SwiftUI: search bar+sort menu(name/modified+ascending/descending)。每行: name+importSourceBadge+description+Toggle enabled+skill detail NavigationLink。Delete swipeActions。Top menu: Import Skill(sheet)+Minis Skills(globe全屏cover browser/市场)+Force iCloud Sync All(iCloudSyncEnabled)

MCP服务器配置: id(servers.json key即server name)/note/enabled/createdAt/updatedAt/url+headers+oauth(非secret)/command+args+env+startupTimeoutSeconds(STDIO)。isHTTP=url非空，isSTDIO=command非空。transportSummary显示https://或npx ...

MCP管理@MainActor @Published servers。servers.json(in MinisConfig persistent dir非minisAppGroupRoot) co-read/write with in-guest minis-mcp-cli(/var/minis/mcp-servers/ bind mount)。表mcp_session_overrides复用skills.db。file shape {"mcpServers":{<name>:{...}}} per-entry decode tolerance。createTime stable-assigned Once。atomic write

Paste JSON导入格式兼容: (1){"mcpServers":{<name>:{…}}}标准Claude-Desktop (2){<name>:{"command"|"url":…}} top-level keys是name (3){"command":"npx",…}单entry(name 'new-server')。disabled:true→enabled:false。oauth 5字段(mode/clientId/authorizationEndpoint/tokenEndpoint/scopes/redirectURI)。支持5个startupTimeout字段alias
Top-20 MCP server系统提示注入。enabled→filter isEnabledForSession→排序createdAt desc+name asc→prefix 20。每行- <id>: <note截断200字符>。追加minis-mcp-cli tools/call用法示例+$$VARNAME运行时环境变量占位符说明

server工具refresh通过in-guest minis-mcp-cli。前置条件ISHKernel.shared.isBooted。执行'minis-mcp-cli refresh <server>'(120s timeout sessionId mcp-settings含/var/minis/mcp-servers mount)。JSON envelope的tools[{name,description}]。ToolsRefreshError: kernelNotBooted/cliFailed

per-server MCPServerItem CK record同步。noteSyncedLocalChange/LocalDelete→markServerDirty。semanticFingerprint排除createdAt/updatedAt。applyRemoteServerItem LWW by updatedAt+2秒slop保留最早createdAt。scanExternalChanges检测CLI edits(fingerprint+updatedAt stamp)。applyRemoteServerDeletion hard-delete

Native OAuth for MCP servers(静态模式)。PKCE Authorization Code flow via ASWebAuthenticationSession。client_secret+tokens存储在LOCAL Keychain(kSecAttrSynchronizable=false永不iCloud)。Bridge file <MinisConfig>/mcp-servers/oauth/<name>.json(chmod 600)让guest daemon self-refresh。loopbackPort=54546。defaultRedirectURI=http://localhost:54546/callback。purge(server:)清理OAuth凭证

非secret OAuth配置(syncs with server)。mode: 'static'=user-supplied creds/'dynamic'=reserved DCR。clientId/authorizationEndpoint/tokenEndpoint/scopes(space-separated)/redirectURI(默认http://localhost:54546/callback)

iOS memory系统: GLOBAL.md(用户维护，agent只读)+YYYY-MM-DD.md(每日日志，timestamped via memory_write)。loadGlobalMemoryFragment全量注入system prompt。loadRecentDailyMemoryFragment近3天日志(200行cap)。executeMemoryWrite: prepend timestamped entry到当天md+ensureFakefsMetadata+iCloud v2 sync MemoryDailyV2 record+post memoryFilesDidChange notification。executeMemoryGet含confidence-based fuzzy scoring(entry命中keywords数+recency score)+500 dump/60 search entries cap

Android memory系统镜像iOS: GLOBAL.md(agent只读)+YYYY-MM-DD.md(timestamp via memory_write)+memory_get(模糊keywords跨文件±2 context window/500 dump lines/60 search lines/30KB byte cap/30天lookback cap)。MAX_INJECT_LINES=200/MAX_RECENT_FILES=3。loadGlobalMemoryFragment/loadRecentDailyMemoryFragment构建<memory> XML block

SOUL.md身份/人格文件。YAML frontmatter: name/emoji(保留但弃用UI固定sparkles)/style/lang(auto/zh/en/free-form)。body作为Layer 1 system prompt注入最顶层identity section。name影响chat bubble头部。serialize()仅写name/style/lang。parse lossless roundtrip。default name=Minis lang=auto

memory展示视图。两级: (1)Auto-injected: SOUL.md(person身份icon)+GLOBAL.md(star)+近3天daily Logs(yesterday标签+200行cap)；(2)Tool Activity: memory_write(平方笔)+memoryGet(放大镜)。所有item点击进入MemoryContentView/MemoryWriteDetailView/MemoryGetDetailView
Memory设置管理界面(Settings→Memory)，管理GLOBAL.md/SOUL.md/daily logs查看编辑

minis:// URL路由枚举。路由: share(shareCoordinator.raisePendingShare)/views/alarm/open_terminal(?init_command)/open(?session+path)WebApp launcher round-trip/session/<id>(legacy)/sessions/<id>(canonical matches minis-sessions-cli)/settings+handleSettings sub-router。sub-router handles: providers[/<instanceId>]/model-groups[/<groupId>]/usage(aliases usage-stats/usage_stats)/skills/memory/storage/mount-external(aliases mount_external/mounts/mounted-folders/mounted_folders)/shared-folders/logs/appearance/background/about/permissions/environments(?create_key/create_value/create_note)/rootfs(aliases mirrors/rootfs-management/rootfs_management)。unknown settings paths fall back to Settings home

@MainActor导航协调器。pendingSettingsTarget驱动SettingsSheet导航stack跳转；pendingEnvVarCreate带key/value/note prefill；pendingRootfsManagement跳Rootfs Management sheet；pendingSessionId跳session切换；pendingLogsTab在LogMgmtView land right tab；pendingFocus [String:Bool?]支持?focus=key:value,key高亮directives。setFocus解析token。SettingsDeepLinkTarget枚举: home/providers/providerDetail/modelGroups/modelGroupDetail/usage/skills/memory/storage/mountedFolders/sharedFolders/logs/appearance/background/about/permissions/environments/mcpIntegrations/mcpServerDetail

minis:// session-scoped unified resource locator规范: namespaces=attachments(media images/.png/.jpg/.webp,audio/.mp3/.m4a,video/.mp4/.mov)+workspace(working scripts/data/config)+offloads(>20k char truncated outputs)+browser(screenshots)。Linux映射minis://<ns>/<path>→/var/minis/<ns>/<path>。session-isolated: Library/MinisChat/minis/<sessionId>/独立目录+harvest→clear→mount→register切换保证原子性。tool result contract: file_write/shell_execute/offload结果附minis_url让模型embed Markdown。security: namespace validation+path traversal rejection(.. rejection)+no session ID in URL
iOS Share Extension: 外部app通过iOS share sheet将文件/text/URL导入Minis会话。MainInterface.storyboard UI
iOS File Provider Extension: 使Minis持久化文件出现在iOS Files app。FileProviderItem/FileProviderEnumerator/FileProviderItem等。AppGroupChangeWatcher监听变化

WKWebView操作的native offload ObjC封装给Swift调用(减少JS bridge开销)。BrowserUseOffloadBridge.swift桥接。其他Offload: Alarm/Bluetooth/Calendar/Clipboard/Config/Debug/Device/FFmpeg/HealthKit/HomeKit/Location/Maps/Media/ModelUse/NFC/NLP/Notification/Open/Photos/Player/Reminders/Sessions/Speak/Speech/Vision/Weather

file_write/file_read直接在host data/读写+iSH fakefs meta.db注册(避免shell escaping+更快)。snapshotMinisFiles遍历/var/minis/。resolveMinisURL映射minis://到ns base(memory/skills/shared/mcp-servers)或session scoped dir。resolveHostPath linux path→host data/。linuxPathToMinisURL反向映射生成minis:// URL。ensureFakefsMetadata写入SQLite meta.db paths+stats表(inode+mode+uid+gid+rdev)
